economic_hypothesis: In high-volatility SOXX regimes with negative serial return correlation, daily-reset SOXL may lose relative compounding value versus SOXX. A positive compounding state could also alter cash participation, but no sign is asserted for that head.
paper_scope: The paper models leverage compounding with return autocorrelation and volatility on SPY/QQQ; it does not establish SOXL/SOXX alpha or supply historical point-in-time features.
clock: Use only completed SOXX/SOXL daily close values through previous native session for current session 09:29 f696 decision; no same-day information.
source_formula: SOXX raw adjusted close-to-close returns r. At each prior completed session s: ac20=corr(r_j,r_{j-1}) over exactly j=s-19..s; vol20=sample std(r_j) over same20; reversal_vol=max(-ac20,0)*vol20^2. Shift one native session to decision day.
prior_scope: stage1_soxx_autocorr_cash_h5_information_20261023 tested ac10 main effect on cash H5 and failed
stage1_path_quality_product_fragility_joint_20261110 tested positive path efficiency times product tracking volatility on next-open equal-beta value and failed
legacy soxl_compounding_regime_sparse_execution.py contains ac20/rv20 thresholds but no saved three-asset source/action/account card; do not treat its thresholds as a candidate
read_population: 2018-10-12 through 2020-12-31 source dates only; no economic label, saved account outcome, or 2021plus market result read
source_gate: At least200 complete source days in each of2019 and2020; exactly one prior completed native session lag; no nonfinite factor on eligible rows; positive factor on at least20 days in each full year.
novelty_gate: Training 2019-2020 source only: no control has abs Spearman>=0.95 with reversal_vol; OLS residual variance fraction beyond intercept and all listed controls>=0.05. These are source representation gates only, not conditional economic information.
if_pass: Separately freeze matched same-wallet whole-share SOXL-vs-SOXX and SOXX-vs-cash fee-net action-value tests, with all main effects and old state/price controls, train/eval clock, one interaction coefficient sign only for SOXL relative value, and finite fit/account budget. Any complete account must use exact f696+b472 parent and SOXX 0/2/5bp hard gates.
if_fail: Close this fixed source formula; do not change window, sign, nonlinear cutoff, provider or source years on reused history.
